## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run test:map-docs
corepack pnpm run test:e2e
corepack pnpm --filter @african-mandate/web run build
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 build/AFRICAN_MANDATE_PROMPTBOOK_v2/prompts/22_UI_MAP_DOCS.md).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 docs/tokens.css).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the frozen install and build exit 0; focused unit reports 7/7; browser reports 13/13 with MapLibre ready, no axe violations, ID-synchronized selection, visible missing/unknown states and both screenshots; full CI reports 21 files / 167 tests plus all determinism/fixture/boundary/schema checks; governance reports 7/7; hashes match this handoff; exact changed paths match; and Prompt 22 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata.

## Diff summary

Prompt 22 adds an isolated, immutable-hash synthetic map/document slice without expanding geography or simulation authority: a MapLibre host, stable-ID synchronized subject list, knowledge-safe dossier, document metadata with separate evidence/assessment, missing/unknown legend, orthography probe and synthetic watermark. It records all non-canonical fields as TEST_ONLY proposals, keeps production GIS/PMTiles/asset claims blocked, reconciles the owner-reviewed Prompt 21 acceptance, and does not promote the fixture to production.
